n318a71ce9f.headline: Thai finmin says economic growth to be driven to 3% this year
n318a71ce9f.summary: Thailand's finance minister said on Monday that growth should reach 3% this year, driven by public spending, tourism and exports. He added that the economy should grow more than 3%.
n318a71ce9f.why: Thailand is a major Southeast Asian economy, and its growth outlook shapes regional tourism, export and investment flows.

nf5acc3480f.headline: Viktor Orbán: Economic Cooperation is the Solid Foundation of German-Hungarian Relations
nf5acc3480f.summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán said in Berlin that trade between the two countries hit a record high of over EUR 70 billion last year, after talks with Chancellor Olaf Scholz.
nf5acc3480f.why: Germany is Hungary's largest trading partner, and bilateral trade links shape manufacturing supply chains such as automotive and batteries.

n83154cd693.headline: Thailand Resumes Sending Agricultural Workers to Israel After Hiatus | Headlines
n83154cd693.summary: Thailand will restart sending agricultural workers to Israel after an eight-month break, aiming for over 10,000 workers by year-end. The first group leaves on Tuesday, and Bangkok has asked Israel to ensure worker safety.
n83154cd693.why: Labour migration agreements shape the supply of foreign workers to key sectors such as farming. Thailand is a major source of such labour, so pauses and restarts affect both countries' labour markets.

ne5bdf1cf62.headline: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial :  Regarding Administrative Action by the Financial Services Agency Form 6 K
ne5bdf1cf62.summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group disclosed an administrative action by the Financial Services Agency in a Form 6-K filing with the US SEC.
ne5bdf1cf62.why: MUFG is one of Japan's largest banks, and regulatory actions by the FSA can affect its business operations, capital requirements and reputation.

n636c8b2492.headline: Japan's Noto quake claims hit $571m. Hyogo hailstorm costs at $355m - Artemis.bm
n636c8b2492.summary: Insurance claims from the January 1 M7.5 Noto earthquake have reached $571 million, according to the General Insurance Association of Japan. Hailstorm costs in Hyogo are put at $355 million.
n636c8b2492.why: Insurers and reinsurers, including catastrophe bond investors, bear large natural catastrophe losses that feed into pricing and capital.

n8fbc780c79.headline: Swedish Government Shifts Focus to Economic Growth Post Inflation Victory | Business
n8fbc780c79.summary: The Swedish government raised its 2024 economic growth forecast, signalling progress against inflation. Finance Minister Elisabeth Svantesson said priorities now include household purchasing power and structural reforms.
n8fbc780c79.why: Sweden's growth and inflation outlook shapes Riksbank policy and the krona. Government fiscal priorities influence the country's bond and currency markets.

na011b9aa75.headline: Youth Employment Agency rolls out BEAP with 1,452 businesses
na011b9aa75.summary: Ghana's Youth Employment Agency has rolled out its Business and Employment Assistance Programme with 1,452 businesses. The programme aims to bolster Ghana's business and employment base.
na011b9aa75.why: Government employment programmes affect labour market conditions and small business support, which matter for development-market investors.

n593ca22aea.headline: Indonesia president proposes reinstating Covid-era bad-debt credit policy; move aims to put liquidity into the banking system
n593ca22aea.summary: Indonesia's president has proposed reinstating a Covid-era policy that relaxed credit rules on bad debts for banks. The aim is to sustain liquidity amid capital outflows, the chief economic minister said after a cabinet meeting.
n593ca22aea.why: Banks are central to credit supply in Indonesia, and rules on bad loans affect their capital and lending capacity. Capital outflows can pressure the rupiah and local bond and equity markets.

nd869e202cb.headline: EU introduces measures to combat sale of cultural property illegally exported from Ukraine
nd869e202cb.summary: The EU's 14th sanctions package against Russia includes measures to combat the import and sale of historical and cultural property illegally exported from Ukraine.
nd869e202cb.why: EU sanctions packages restrict trade and financial access, shaping compliance obligations for businesses dealing with Russia and the EU market.

n8a1b34ac8f.headline: China Floats Perks for German Carmakers to Prevent EV Levies
n8a1b34ac8f.summary: Beijing has suggested Germany's luxury carmakers could benefit if Berlin convinces the European Union to drop tariffs on Chinese electric-vehicle exports. The proposal links EV trade barriers to German automakers.
n8a1b34ac8f.why: EU tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles and retaliatory measures shape margins and market access for German premium carmakers in China.

nf2b963cea2.headline: Bread price drop: millers announce the
nf2b963cea2.summary: Industrial millers in Senegal decided to temporarily stop flour production due to a state-imposed bread flour price reduction that makes production financially unviable.
nf2b963cea2.why: Price controls affecting key food inputs can disrupt supply chains and impact inflation and food security in local economies.

n297a69425e.why: International investment balances reflect foreign capital flows and economic stability, important for assessing Palestine's economic health and investment climate.

n86d41eee15.summary: Supermarkets may face fines; Armaguard receives a $50 million lifeline; other corporate news in Australia.
n86d41eee15.why: Corporate developments can influence stock prices and sector sentiment in Australia.

nee8004c212.headline: Stock market update: Stocks that hit 52-week lows on NSE in today
nee8004c212.summary: IndusInd Bank, Cipla, Adani Ports, Coal India, and Tata Steel declined to 52-week lows on NSE today.
nee8004c212.why: Declines in these major stocks indicate sector-specific or broader market concerns affecting Indian equities.
nee8004c212.why_moved: Market volatility and sector pressures caused stock lows, impacting investor confidence in Indian markets.

n3df86cebba.headline: Euronext Amsterdam Insights: Three Stocks Estimated To Be Below Their Fair Value In June 2024
n3df86cebba.summary: European markets, including the Netherlands, show signs of recovery, with investors focusing on undervalued stocks with potential for appreciation.
n3df86cebba.why: Identifying undervalued stocks can present investment opportunities during market recoveries and economic shifts.

n96fbf63e60.headline: Dollar Rises As Fed Perceived More Hawkish Than Peers
n96fbf63e60.summary: The US dollar strengthened during the week amid perceptions that the Federal Reserve is more hawkish than other major central banks.
n96fbf63e60.why: A hawkish Fed outlook supports the dollar, affecting currency markets, US yields, and global capital flows.

nb70fa45c13.headline: Dutch home prices rose 8.6% in May to new record
nb70fa45c13.summary: Home prices in the Netherlands rose by 8.6% in May, reaching a new record with an average of 445,430 euros, driven by strong demand.
nb70fa45c13.why: Rising home prices reflect a hot real estate market, affecting household wealth and mortgage lending in the Netherlands.

n00098b8127.headline: Exclusive: Nigerian Banks begin payment of $132 million USSD debt to telcos
n00098b8127.summary: Nigerian banks have started repaying a $132 million debt owed to telecom companies for USSD services, with the total amount including interest likely to rise if payments delay.
n00098b8127.why: Resolution of payment disputes between banks and telecoms affects sector liquidity and operational stability in Nigeria.

ncb41da36f6.headline: Last Week of the First Semester Provides an 'X-Ray' of the Brazilian Economy
ncb41da36f6.summary: The last week of the first semester brings Copom data, an inflation preview, employment indicators and public accounts figures. These releases form a snapshot of the Brazilian economy.
ncb41da36f6.why: The Copom is Brazil's central bank monetary policy committee, and its decisions drive the Selic interest rate that anchors domestic borrowing costs.

n3b01ed90e2.why: The VN-Index tracks the largest listed companies on Vietnam's stock exchanges, and foreign flows are a major driver of its liquidity and direction.

n257ccfacba.summary: A Senate member cited a UNCTAD finding that Egypt led Africa in foreign direct investment inflows in recent years, reaching $10 billion in 2023. He credited business-climate reforms.
n257ccfacba.why: Foreign direct investment funds infrastructure and job creation, and it is a key input for Egypt's external financing.

n25a65e163b.summary: Cyprus parliamentary committees will discuss progress on the Vasilikos LNG terminal and the Cyprus-Greece-Israel electricity interconnection. They will also review compensation for fire victims and the OPAP report.

n63a480df0f.headline: Over 67 Tons of Lobsters Dead: Interest-Free Support Offered to Farmers
n63a480df0f.summary: Farmers hit by the death of over 67 tons of lobsters in Song Cau town, Phu Yen province, are receiving bank support. Measures include interest-free loans, debt freezes and new loans.
n63a480df0f.why: Aquaculture is an important export and livelihood sector in Vietnam, and bank relief measures affect local credit exposure.
